description:
A retro-inspired 20-inch fat tire eBike built for comfort, power, and long-range urban or off-road adventures.

2500W Peak Motor delivers strong acceleration and climbing power.

48V 20Ah Battery supports up to 55 miles of riding range.

20" x 4.0" Fat Tires provide enhanced grip on sand, gravel, snow, and city roads.

Full Suspension System improves riding comfort over bumps and uneven terrain.

NFC Smart Unlock adds convenient and modern anti-theft access.

7-Speed Shimano Transmission gives riders more control across different road conditions.

IPX6 Water Resistance helps protect against splashes and wet conditions.

365 lbs Max Payload supports heavier riders and daily carrying needs.

The T20 Retro Fat Tire Electric Bike combines vintage styling with modern electric performance. Powered by a 2500W peak motor and a 48V 20Ah battery, this retro cruiser is built for riders who want power, comfort, and long-range capability in one stylish package.
Its 20" x 4.0" fat tires deliver excellent traction across city streets, gravel paths, beach roads, and light trails, while the full suspension system helps absorb bumps for a smoother ride. With up to 55 miles of max range, a 30 MPH top speed, and 50 Nm of torque, the F20 is designed for weekend adventures, daily commuting, and recreational cruising.
The T20 also features NFC Smart Unlock, precision disc brakes, IPX6 water resistance, and a 7-speed Shimano drivetrain, making it a practical and fun electric bike for riders who want both style and performance.

components.description: Relaxed cruising with a retro-inspired design
